name: Mark Davis

views.text: A famous name can reset a franchise faster than a slow build.
I lean on people I trust, like Tom, to run football operations.
One bad season is enough to make a change at head coach.
The Raiders should matter in Las Vegas the way they did in Oakland.
Draft picks at the top of the board are a chance to change the quarterback story.
Winning the division again is the first proof we are back.

signatures: invokes his father and the Raiders' past
want: A winner worthy of the Raiders' history in the new Las Vegas era (medium).
fear: Remaining the franchise that churns through head coaches (medium).
voice: Folksy and candid, with an unusual frankness about mistakes. Talks about family history and Raider Nation. Delegates football detail to his executives.

evidence.summary: Davis fired Pete Carroll after one season with the league's worst record; GM John Spytek will lead football operations with minority owner Tom Brady, including the coach search.
After firing Antonio Pierce after one full season, the Raiders moved to hire 73-year-old Super Bowl winner Pete Carroll, with Brady involved in the search.

review.notes: Thin coverage: two to four sources found by web search (2026-11-06); sliders mostly left at 5; a few publication dates are taken from the news cycle the article covers. Draft for JR to check.
